claims.object_text: Slc6a1-OPCs sub-cluster in hippocampus of db-/- diabetic mice
claims.quote: More in-depth analysis of oligodendrocyte precursor cells(OPCs) showed five distinct OPCs sub-clusters including expressing marker gene Lingo2-OPCs, Kcnc1-OPCs, Sst-OPCs, Slc6a1-OPCs and Lhfpl3-OPCs

claims.object_text: proliferate, migrate, and finally differentiate into mature oligodendrocytes and produce myelin
claims.quote: Slc6a1-OPCs and Lhfpl3-OPCs, which seems to be able to proliferate, migrate, and finally differentiate into mature oligodendrocytes and produce myelin.
